about: In My Name is Mayo: Remayo, the real-life tapping, clicking adventure of a Mayo Jar returns! This time in graphics so 4K you can almost taste the Mayo! And for every first-timer and veteran Mayo-clicker alike, you can enjoy the brand new Pachinko minigame that will surely give you the overstimulation your brain craves!
You will ReLive its story, ReUnpackage the emotional baggage, and (maybe) you will ReLearn from them while unlocking 50 coveted trophies!! This is the touching story about a Mayo Jar, ReMade! ReMayo!
Unlock 50 unique trophies including a Platinum!
Compete with your friends and the world with the online tapping leaderboard!
summary: In My Name is Mayo: Remayo, the real-life tapping, clicking adventure of a Mayo Jar returns! This time in graphics so 4K you can almost taste the Mayo!
